_comment: Every action (combat skill) a unit can use: fight/combat_skill.gd, read by fight/actions/action_table.gd. Bot skills name one through bot_skill_effects in combat_tuning.json; enemies list them in enemy_tables.json. Every number is a first guess, not balance.
_fields_comment: name, energy_cost (whole points), power_percent (damage per hit or hp restored, in percent of attack; for a guard, the share of the next hit blocked; for an absorb, the share of the user's Defense absorbed). effect: damage (default), heal, guard (blocks a share of the next hit) or absorb (Brace: absorbs damage up to power_percent of Defense, over any number of hits, until the target's next action). target: opponent (default for damage), all_opponents, ally (default for heal and guard; the user included) or self.
_rework_fields_comment: Combat rework fields, all optional: recovery (gauge pushed back after acting, default 0; S2), hit_count (hits per use, each of power_percent; default 1), damage_type (default untyped ""; S13), tags (labels for the action tagger; S6), applies_status (a statuses.json id put on each target still up after the action's hits), payoff_condition (a statuses.json id the target must hold) with payoff_bonus_percent (extra damage in percent against it; fight/damage_pipeline.gd).
_shred_comment: TODO(decision: shred-in-drafts): shred is in the catalog only. No bot skill (bot_skill_effects, data/bot_data/skills.json), draft, enemy or demo uses it until S9's sandbox, so runs and goldens do not change.
